I added the column and the type field. I haven't run the migration or a type-check.

- **Migration:** `migrations/003_expert_timezone.sql` contains `alter table experts add column timezone text;`. The column is nullable, so existing rows are fine. It stores the IANA name as plain text, with no database check on the value.
- **Type:** `src/experts/types.ts` now has `timezone?: string;` on `Expert`.

I didn't touch `src/experts/experts.ts`. I searched `src` for the existing `country` field and it only appears in the type, so I'm guessing the queries there don't list columns by name. I didn't open the file to check. If they do, `timezone` will need adding there to be read or written.
